channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: Stakes are high as BYU women’s basketball team visits Utah
item.description: The Utah women's basketball team on Saturday gets a chance to avenge its January loss to BYU. The Cougars' and Utes' NCAA Tournament hopes could ride on the result.

item.title: Salt Lake City: Two new restaurants offering omakase experiences are coming to the downtown area
item.description: Uchi, Japanese for “home,” was founded by a James Beard Award-winning chef Tyson Cole in Austin, Texas.

item.title: After two bankruptcies, a Utah entrepreneur found success selling secret doors
item.description: Utah entrepreneur Jeremy Barker turned his hidden-door idea into Murphy Door, a $60 million business producing custom doors and cupboards, disguised as bookshelves and other furniture.

item.title: Letter: A cap on water use by Utah businesses would be a good step forward
item.description: Letter: Our kids will be inheriting a lot of problems in the name of progress, including a depletion of regenerative natural resources like water.

item.title: Letter: Resorting to ‘bathroom humor’ undermines Pat Bagley’s gifts
item.description: Letter: It deeply saddens me to see Pat Bagley resort to “bathroom humor” in his comics about Donald Trump.

item.title: Letter: A modest proposal to help end the Morehouse College-Joseph Smith controversy
item.description: Letter: The LDS Church should prominently install a portrait of The Rev. Martin Luther King, Jr. on Temple Square next to a portrait of one of its own prophets.

item.title: Letter: Most Utahns have had nothing but praise for mail-in voting. If it ain’t broke, don’t fix it.
item.description: Letter: I fail to understand how making it difficult, or even impossible, for people to vote will make America great again.

item.title: Big Cottonwood Canyon avalanche leaves 2 men hospitalized after other skiers ‘immediately’ helped rescue them
item.description: The eight nearby skiers helped pull the men from the snow before they were taken to a Salt Lake Valley hospital.

item.title: Brother of girl swept up in Brighton-area avalanche ‘heroically’ found 11-year-old before she died, police say
item.description: More than 20 strangers had jumped in to help family members, ski patrollers and police search for the 11-year-old girl suddenly caught in the backcountry avalanche just outside of Brighton Ski Resort's boundaries.
